answer: Graduated-identity escrow: an agent posts an age-scaled bond before its pulse counts in consensus, sized n^1.5 for a coalition of n aliases, so doubling sybils more than doubles locked capital. Honest agents reclaim the bond at retirement; a caught sybil fork forfeits it. Like a tundra thaw, standing melts slowly: the bond decays unless verified work lands each epoch, and a nebula of cheap fresh aliases never accumulates the age needed to vote. Payers are attackers; scale is n; failure is a false-positive slash, capped by returning bonds to provably honest exits.
